notes.title: We Made A Wood & Weather Picrew!
notes.content:
[h2]HEY[/h2]
It has been such a long year and we wanted to thank everyone for the support they've shown us and Wood & Weather by making a Picrew!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42741617/393d51c9461f97580fe77e78151e1c4e04eebad7.gif[/img]
[h1][url=https://picrew.me/ja/image_maker/2049406]⚡️CREATE A WOODEN TOY CHARACTER⚡️[/url][/h1]

For those of you unaware of what "[i]Picrew[/i]" is, it's a little web-based character creator. Use it to make a wooden toy version of yourself, a friend, a weirdo, someone you wish was in the game or just anyone you can think of!

A huge amount of work went into putting this together by our artist Cole and we've already seen so many fun creations already!

Thank you also to everyone who has Followed, Wishlisted and played the demo of Wood & Weather. We appreciate all of the feedback and kind words people have said to us over the year. We also really loved being able to do some in-person events this year too!

We had high hopes of releasing the full game this year, but things didn't work out as we originally planned. That being said, next year is going to be a big one for us and we can't wait to share what we've been working on! We're on a much needed break until Jan 2024(!)

Hope you all have a great holiday break and snap up some [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/916900/Paperbark/]decent games in the Winter Steam Sale![/url]

Love you all,

- Paper House ːwombatloveː

notes.title: BREAK OUR GAME
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42741617/90dd655c162d7b0766ad3a6410b5af6475a92d97.png[/img]

[b][h3]Making videogames is really hard, but breaking videogames is pretty easy. [/h3][/b]
It's an honest and complicated situation because the nature of this relationship is completely conflicting but mutually beneficial. It basically just comes down to the fact you can't make a game if it's broken and you can't break a game if it isn't made. So we all get left in a kind of balancing act where we can only go so far, or do so much before we need to focus back in on ourselves, make sure everything is alright and then continue forwards. 

While we do our absolute best to test the game, fix issues and make sure the game is stable as possible before we put it in your hot little (blue) hands, we're only a small team and can do so much. ːsteamthumbsupː

[h2]That's why we're asking you to download the [i]Wood & Weather[/i] demo and do everything in your power to break our game. [/h2]

We don't really care how or what you do, [b]you just need to tell/show us.[/b] You could get something stuck in the world, fly off the map or crash the game from a physics glitch, it's entirely up to you! 

Head over to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1677010/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] and tell us whats up. 
You can also email us at [url=support@paperhousegames.com]support@paperhousegames.com[/url]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677010/Wood__Weather/

We know what our flaws are (and what we have omitted from the demo) but [b]we'd also love some of your feedback too![/b] Tell us what you think, what you loved, what you'd change, what you expected, whatever you want really. 

We're making a game about wooden toys and the weather and while the wood might be hard, we are not, so don't be mean, we don't want you to be mean to us.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42741617/fed55671cf2ce745518afda4264045004563988d.jpg[/img]
[i](this screenshot took 5 minutes to render on a pretty decent computer)[/i]

We really appreciate all the support everyone has given us so far and you potentially ruining something we put our blood, sweat and tears into every day.

Be nice,

Paper House
[url=www.paperhousegames.com]www.paperhousegames.com[/url]

notes.title: Steam NextFest - Developer Broadcast
notes.content:
[h3]We're a part of Steam's NextFest June 2023![/h3]

It's really exciting for us to be along side such an exciting selection of up-coming games and demos!
Obviously our demo went live with our Wholesome Direct announcement- HOWEVER! For the duration of NextFest, we'll be broadcasting a bunch of playthroughs and commentary from the developers (us)!

🔴 We recorded all of the streams in the front of our shop! So we get interrupted a little bit and you can see some of the books and things on the shelves. The streams involve Jack, Sam, Terry & some cameos from people wandering through the studio.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest]NextFest[/url][/b] runs from [b]June 19 - June 26 @ 10:00AM Pacific[/b] so be sure to watch us talk a bunch. 

[h3][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561198840973475]
YOU CAN WATCH US RIGHT HERE[/url][/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42741617/5f271750271c2107c4d88d2fb196ca155e8815c3.png[/img]


We've also done a minor update to the Wood & Weather Demo to fix up some bugs that we're aware of.

🌦️ [b]Demo Update Notes:[/b]
- Fix bug preventing players from starting the game if their device has a touchscreen
- Fix Birch registering the wrong item as their favourite thing
- Prevent Dragoljub from trying to hold the tram handle
- Allow players to submit menu elements with Enter and Space button
- Update dialogue with improved hints for some quests and favourite things
- Fix some bugs that occur when navigating menus with a mouse

Thank you again to everyone who has played our game so far! The response has been amazing and we really value any feedback you might have!

Don't forget to [b]Wishlist/Follow[/b] for all those who celebrate.

Lost of love xo
- Paper House

notes.title: Paper House x Parallels 2022 - Live Recording!
notes.content:
[h3]The live recording of Parallels 2022 is now on YouTube!
[/h3]

During October last year we were honored with hosting Parallels 2022 as part of Melbourne International Games Week. Parallels is an annual event which showcases a bunch of locally made games and gives developers an opportunity to talk more openly about their creative process and [i]why[/i] they decided to make their game.

We thought it would be fun to (very cheekily) show off Wood & Weather for the first time.

You can now watch the entire event on YouTube. [b]Our little announcement is around the 2 : 07 : 22 mark[/b], but the whole event is worth watching. 

[previewyoutube=TFkTnglxwkM;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks again to Freeplay for letting us host such an incredible the event.

- Paper House

notes.title: ☀️ Wood & Weather - Announcement Trailer 🌦
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ideURBUsqhs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Wood & Weather - Announcement Trailer![/h1]

Near the end of last year we hosted a local indie games event called [url=https://www.freeplay.net.au/parallels-2022/]Parallels[/url]. It was a big deal for us and for the local games community here in Melbourne, Australia.

As a bit of a surprise to everyone at the event, we thought it would be fun to show off Wood & Weather for the first time publicly to a private room of 400 people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42741617/c914569f54d77f8f58d4e4428222d946ac7bfd9a.jpg[/img]
(Photo by [url=https://www.brettscapinphotography.com/]Brett Scaplin[/url])

[h2]BUT NOW WE'RE SHARING IT WITH EVERYONE IN THE WORLD![/h2]
We've all been working really really hard to make sure Wood & Weather is the best game it can be and it feels really nice to finally be able to show it off. 

There will be more details shared that go more into the nitty-gritty of the game later in the year and we look forward to sharing more things soon!

Thanks again to everyone who has helped us over development so far. The love, support and feedback is immeasurable. 

☀️ ⛈ 🍃 ❄️ 🌈

- Paper House
